title: Harden A2 liveness: compare process start time, treat EPERM as unknown
description: processAlive in internal/exec/subprocess/process_unix.go:21-37 is kill(pid,0) with no start-time comparison and treats EPERM as alive, so a reused pid reads live. ma5 bounded the consequence (settlement deadline refuses attempt_unaddressed past the attempt's own wall clock) but the check itself is unhardened. Record the supervisor's start time in the attempt record and compare it on inspect (sysctl kinfo_proc on darwin, /proc/<pid>/stat starttime on linux); EPERM means 'exists, not ours' and should be reported as unknown, not alive. Source: final re-review of qeu, A2 partial.
